entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 607158571490718208: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.0106 +/- 0.0564 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 124.84 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -15.659, -10.646 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 607158571490718208 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 40,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.28 +/- 0.02 solar radii from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-332 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract). Mass 0.27 +/- 0.01 solar masses from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-332 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.508..195D/abstract). Temperature 3315 +/- 137 K from de Leon et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-332 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,315 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc281. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,315 K and log g 4.98 (u1 0.154, u2 0.458): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
